sonnet.problem: The blank asks what the camels finished doing ("drinking"). Card 8 (Rebekah says she will draw water for the camels) and card 9 (she keeps going until all the camels are watered) already made this point, so the answer is given away and the card re-asks the same fact. The question also says the servant "waits until" the camels finish, but the text only says he took out the gifts after they finished drinking.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
